title: API Scenario Patch
user: Small API teams that need to review a realistic, multi-step request scenario in Git without sharing a hosted API-client workspace.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI/proxy that records an opted-in sequence of HTTP exchanges, replaces configured secrets with placeholders, extracts selected response values into named variables, and writes a deterministic Markdown plus YAML scenario patch.
success_measure: At least 50% of pilot scenario patches are reviewed in a normal pull request without a reviewer asking for an external workspace or copied credentials.
constraints: Default-deny recording of authorization headers, cookies, and bodies; redact JSON paths before writing; make replay explicit and disabled by default.
